description:
Sets when Nudges (reminder emails) go out for every Chase, including ones already running, counted from the date Clients are asked to send by (the ask-by date): days before it, on the day, and days after it, sent at 09:00 UK time on weekdays. A value left out keeps its current setting. Returns the plan in words and this Quarter's remaining nudge dates.
Use this when: the practitioner wants reminders on different days.
Not for: one extra reminder now (send_nudges_now), one Client (pause_nudges), or the ask-by date itself (update_practice).

days_after.description: 1–60, up to 6 values: days after it

days_before.description: 1–60, up to 6 values: days before the date clients are asked to send by

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

on_the_day.description: also nudge on the ask-by date itself

name: set_nudge_plan
title: Set the nudge plan
